5215.title: Plugin selection missing from command catalog
5215.rootCauseOneLine: The commands endpoint omits the plugin agent skill selection that runtime construction supplies to the shared catalog.
5215.proposedFix: Define existing-thread and pre-thread preview context, then share effective skill selection between runtime and composer catalog.
5215.caveats: API/runtime boundary reproduced for both provider registrations. No browser or real provider turn. No simple fix PR: missing context semantics require a product/public-contract decision.
